title: AlphaSense Occupies New Global HQ at Hudson Commons, NYC
source: PR Newswire / Crain's New York Business
summary: AlphaSense began occupying its new global HQ at Hudson Commons (441 Ninth Avenue) in early 2026, following a June 2025 announcement of a 10-year, 50,000 sq ft lease. The move from Union Square accommodates AlphaSense's growth to 2,000+ global employees and $500M+ ARR.
